behavior: AC1: make e2e-linux runs the Linux scenario on a fresh Ubuntu guest and exits 0 only when no case is FAIL or XPASS
AC2: make e2e-windows does the same on a Windows 11 Arm64 guest with the real PowerShell reads and writes
AC3: no tsb-e2e session is left after a run or after make e2e-clean, and e2e-clean is idempotent
verification: make e2e-clean && make e2e-clean && ! dotf vm linux status 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^tsb-e2e-' && ! dotf vm windows status 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^tsb-e2e-'

behavior: AC4: the second host setup reports no changed step and every drift case is detected and repaired, on both OSes
verification: l=$(ls -t scripts/e2e/out/linux-*.log | head -1) && w=$(ls -t scripts/e2e/out/windows-*.log | head -1) && grep -q '^PASS setup #2: nothing changed' "$l" && grep -q '^PASS setup #2: nothing changed' "$w" && ! grep -q '^FAIL drift' "$l" "$w"

behavior: AC5: XFAIL does not fail the run; FAIL and XPASS do
AC6: the runbook exists and the release runbook links it
